Chapter 1: Tower of Sighs

In the cold mists of the Haunted Marshes stands the Tower of Sighs, a red-stone watchtower of the dragon empire raised over a spring that makes lies impossible. Long ago warring orc clans met here until a betrayal and a fire spell ended in massacre, and the starved spirits of orc chieftains still wail beneath a boulder-choked stair. Now the wily giant Glam-Glam sleeps on the ground floor, stringing along Ursic One-Ear's bandits, who believe gold lies below and want the heroes to kill the giant for them. The heroes must choose whom to trust, clear the way to the forgotten temple, free the restless dead, and claim the gifts of Acha Bonebreaker — and then survive Ursic's betrayal when the 'treasure' proves not to be gold.
